—
Lil Uzi Vert, born Symere Bysil Woods in Philadelphia, is an American rapper and singer who became one of the defining figures of the late 2010s Soundcloud rap boom and contemporary emo-trap. Recognized for a genre-bending aesthetic that blends hip-hop with punk, pop-punk, and emo influences, they built a massive global fanbase around chaotic energy, fast-paced vocal delivery, and an eccentric personal style.

They first broke into the mainstream with successful early mixtapes like *Luv Is Rage* and *Lil Uzi Vert vs. The World*, along with a featured verse on Migos’ hit single “Bad and Boujee”. Their stardom skyrocketed with the 2017 release of their debut studio album, *Luv Is Rage 2*, which debuted at number one on the Billboard 200. The album featured the massive double-platinum single “XO Tour Llif3,” an emotional breakup anthem that solidified Uzi’s ability to turn vulnerabilities into arena-sized hits.

Known as much for their unconventional fashion as their music, Uzi frequently makes headlines with experimental outfits, face tattoos, and dramatic viral moments—including temporarily having a $24 million pink diamond implanted into their forehead. Their follow-up albums, such as *Eternal Atake* and *Pink Tape*, continued to dominate the charts by pairing heavy bass-lines with high-concept sci-fi themes and electronic textures. Today, Uzi remains one of modern rap’s most unpredictable headliners and a key catalyst in blending alternative rock culture into hip-hop.
